name: Conversational Stance Detection (challenge) dataset
description: A challenge dataset for detecting stance in conversational text (e.g., agreement, disagreement, neutrality) and evaluating models on this task.
reputation: A challenge dataset for conversational stance detection with limited but growing use among stance-detection and social-computing researchers.
notes: Conversational context and inter-annotator variability can make labels noisy; potential class imbalance and small/medium dataset size. Primarily a text classification benchmark rather than an LLM-native evaluation.
